name: fix
description: Fix a bug or a list of review findings with a test that fails on the original bug. Use for "fix this" or "address these findings".

# Guide: fix

Say "Mode: fix." Use the `implement` skill with a fix brief: the claim to fix, the invariants that must hold, and where the same mistake may repeat. A one- or two-line fix with an obvious cause can be done directly with a test that fails on the original bug; say the full path was skipped and why.
